newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai securities trading turnover hits new high.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai securities trading turnover hits new high.

text.p: Turnover of shares on the Shanghai Stock Exchange in the first four months of this year hit 571.3 billion yuan, a massive 673 percent up on the same period of 1996, the Shanghai Securities News said on Tuesday.
Treasury bonds trading on the exchange in the period totalled 638.9 billion yuan, an increase of 339 percent compared with the same period last year, it said.

Trading on China's stock markets suddenly jumped in April last year after a review by the leadership in Beijing concluded the markets were basically healthy and further development would be beneficial to the economy. They have been booming ever since.
